Mastech × Fitness Marvel · 04 · Source: Fitness Marvel brief and fitnessmarvel.com
Why Fitness Marvel is different
Built for the gym, not the office
A generic attendance machine
  • Designed for offices and factories
  • Staff update the device by hand when a member renews, freezes or expires
  • Knows nothing about packages, time slots or sessions
  • Someone still has to guard the door at restricted hours
Cloud-to-device automation
New member, renewal, expiry, freeze or resume reaches the device within seconds when connected. No manual updates.
Gym-specific rules
Time slots, allowed days and per-session access, enforced automatically by each member’s active package and schedule.
Continuity
Devices keep enforcing the permissions already synced, even if the internet or middleware drops.
Mastech × Fitness Marvel · 05 · Source: Fitness Marvel brief
The hero story of the campaign
The shared hall, solved at the door
Many Pakistani gyms run one hall with different hours for different groups, including ladies-only hours. Today a staff member stands at the entrance to stop members at the wrong time.
With Fitness Marvel, each member’s permitted hours live in their package. The gate allows, blocks and allows again on its own, even offline once rules are synced.
No guard at the door. No awkward stops.

Pakistani market mentality
How gym owners here actually decide
“Kaun use kar raha hai?”
Trust comes from who else uses it.
So we show real gyms and owners (with permission), never stock models.
“Pehle dikhao.”
Seeing it work beats any brochure.
So we film the gate deciding on camera and invite owners to see it live.
WhatsApp is the sales floor.
Owners ask, compare and decide in chats.
So we end every ad in WhatsApp, answered in minutes in Urdu or English.
“Price kya hai?”
Price comes up in the first message.
So we lead with value and 0% markup installments, and reply with a quick call.
Owners trust owners.
Word of mouth moves faster than ads.
So we run referral rewards and owner meet-ups, and the founder speaks peer to peer.
Respect wins.
Owners won’t share content that shames staff or members.
So we talk about control and smooth operations, and show ladies-only hours with care.
Language: Roman Urdu hooks for reach, clean English for credibility, Urdu captions on every video.

The campaign arc

Phase 1 · Weeks 1–4
Awareness
Goal · Plant “fitness tech = Fitness Marvel” in every target owner’s mind
Content · Launch film, shared-hall Reel, founder intro, category explainers
Measure · Reach, frequency, video views, brand searches
Phase 2 · Weeks 5–8
Consideration
Goal · Show why purpose-built beats generic, and spark upgrade thinking
Content · Side-by-side demos, owner stories, product walk-throughs, LinkedIn deep-dives
Measure · 75% video views, profile and site visits, saves, DMs
Phase 3 · Weeks 9–12
Leads
Goal · Turn warm owners into qualified demo requests
Content · WhatsApp check offer, instant lead forms, high-intent search ads
Measure · Qualified leads, cost per lead, demos booked

Targeting and keywords
Reach gym owners, not gym-goers
Facebook · Instagram
  • Radius around gym clusters in Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad and Rawalpindi
  • Ages 24–55; fitness industry, gym equipment and small-business interests
  • Retarget 50%+ video viewers, engagers and WhatsApp chats
  • Lookalikes from leads and clients once 100+ exist
Google
  • Keywords: gym management software, gym software Pakistan, gym biometric attendance, gym turnstile gate, plus city names
  • Brand: Fitness Marvel
  • Negatives: jobs, salary, free download, gym near me, membership fee, home workout
LinkedIn
  • Titles: owner, founder, CEO, managing director, general manager, operations manager
  • Industries: health, wellness and fitness; hotels with gyms
  • Lists: target gyms and chains uploaded as a company list
Rule: any ad set that pulls in gym-goers instead of owners is cut within a week.
